claims.location: comment[data file], source name, technical replicate, fraction identifier, all 96 rows
claims.value: 96 RAW acquisitions from 8 biological preparations, each analyzed in 6 fractions by Standard and Sensitive methods
claims.evidence: Every PRIDE RAW filename matches (1D or 8D) × replicate 01–04 × fraction F1–F6 × standard or x-suffixed Sensitive acquisition. PRIDE protocol explicitly says six StageTip fractions and two technical methods, with x indicating Sensitive.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], cell type, cell line and Cellosaurus accession, all rows
claims.value: Mus musculus ES-R1 embryonic stem cells, CVCL_2167
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample protocol names mouse ES-R1 cells; Cellosaurus CVCL_2167 identifies ES-R1 as a mouse embryonic stem cell line.
Cellosaurus CVCL_2167 records the sex of the source cell line as male.

claims.location: characteristics[SUMOylation inhibition history] and factor value, all rows
claims.value: 1D untreated control versus 8D ML-792 2.5 µM for 48 h followed by 5 d recovery
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample protocol identifies untreated D1 and recovered D8 conditions after 48 h ML-792 treatment and 5 d recovery; raw names encode 1D and 8D.

claims.location: comment[instrument] and acquisition method, all rows
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample-processing protocol names Orbitrap Exploris 480, precursor selection and HCD fragmentation.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], two repeated columns, all rows
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol describes Lys-C digestion, SUMO2/3 peptide immunoprecipitation with 8A2, then Asp-N digestion. The source table has both enzymes, and the deterministic generator expands them into repeated SDRF cleavage columns.

claims.location: characteristics[developmental stage] and characteristics[strain or breed], all rows
claims.evidence: Cellosaurus CVCL_2167 identifies the donor age at sampling as Blastocyst stage and the cell-line source breed/subspecies as 129X1/SvJ x 129S1/Sv-Oca2+Tyr+KitlSl-J. The ontology maps the documented mammalian blastocyst to blastula stage (UBERON:0000108).

limitations: The validator cannot resolve exact ES-R1 in its CLO/BTO/EFO ontology cache; Cellosaurus CVCL_2167 verifies the exact line and the SDRF preserves that accession.
The deposited search protocol mentions Lys-C, Asp-N and Glu-N in silico; Glu-N is not listed as a physical digestion reagent, so it is not declared.
Detailed SUMO remnant search modifications and mass tolerances were not encoded because the deposited prose is insufficient for reliable SDRF values.
The reconcile helper reads repeated cleavage headers as one field and can report an incomplete digest even when both physical enzymes are present.
